name: Holzer Astrid
beschreibung: The holiday apartment 'Holzer Astrid' is located in a quiet residential area in Tirol. The accommodation is equipped with a fully equipped kitchen and a cozy living area. The bedroom offers comfortable beds and ample storage space. In the surroundings there are numerous hiking and cycling trails. Guests can use the nearby ski and mountain areas. The apartment has a private bathroom with shower. The rooms are bright and practically furnished. Nearby there are shopping facilities and restaurants.
